summary: Left on the Moon is a 10-slide presentation that catalogs the machines and equipment NASA left on the lunar surface during the Ranger, Surveyor, Lunar Orbiter and Apollo programs
details:
Intended impact

The aim is to help students and the public see that the Moon holds a record of human exploration. Some of that hardware is still useful, such as the laser retroreflectors still used to measure the Earth–Moon distance. It also shows that leaving equipment behind was a deliberate engineering choice, not carelessness.
